messages:
anya: quick question who owns prewarm policy for dedicated GPU pools: control-plane or operator?

matt: lean control-plane for policy + telemetry. operator executes intents.

ryan: operator needs admission (throttle/defer) to avoid local thrash.

sasha: propose "intent ticket" model: ticket fields = id, owner, desired_count, ttl, priority, cache_hint. operator ACKs with ACCEPTED/QUEUED/PROVISIONED/REJECTED.

jen: migration: translate existing desired_count pushes into ephemeral tickets during rollout.

anya: operator should heartbeat when provisioning; control-plane may extend TTL. also include probe_window to check warm nodes first.

matt: add cache_hint for KV prefixes so operator prefers warmed nodes.

ryan: tickets must carry tenant sig/nonce and idempotency key. operator logs ticket_id for billing reconciliation.

sasha: ops TODOs: add prewarm_backpressure metric, ticket heartbeat endpoint, quick reject codes. i'll own operator changes.

jen: control-plane TODOs: ticket API, migration shim, RFC draft. i'll own the RFC.

anya: owners set. follow-up sync next Tue. thanks.
